latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the critic stage and marked the same native Goal complete. The native-reported elapsed time was 7m 8s.

The critique finds no material wrong correction to the plan, but identifies material gaps in author attribution, concurrent move resolution, reconnect recovery, and how resolutions handle newly arriving edits. These are supported by the versioned [Automerge Rust API](https://docs.rs/automerge/0.12.0/automerge/struct.Automerge.html), [list merge rules](https://automerge.org/docs/reference/under-the-hood/merge-rules/), [move-CRDT paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.14007v2), and [Rust sync issue #1284](https://github.com/automerge/automerge/issues/1284). Proposed validations remain unrun.
